sentences.en: Now that my only colleague has retired, I'm flying solo.
sentences.zh: 现在我的唯一一位同事已经退休了，我只能单干。

sentences.en: Better to go solo than to be in bad company.
sentences.zh: 与其和坏人在一起，不如独自一人。

sentences.en: Lindbergh's solo nonstop transatlantic flight was a remarkable accomplishment.
sentences.zh: 林德伯格的不着陆横跨大西洋独飞是一项非凡的成就。
